description: Check a crypto address before sending money: EVM (EIP-55 checksum, catches typos), Bitcoin legacy / P2SH / SegWit / Taproot (base58check and bech32/bech32m checksums), Solana, Tron and other bech32 chains. Also flags private keys and transaction hashes pasted by mistake. Costs $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
name: address_validate
title: address validate
